When applying for a visa, permanent residency, or citizenship, properly authenticated documents are essential to ensure your immigration process goes smoothly. Failing to provide verified paperwork can lead to delays, rejections, or even legal complications. That’s why understanding how to authenticate immigration documents is a crucial step for anyone navigating Canadian or international immigration systems.   Authentication confirms that your documents—such as birth certificates, degrees, police clearances, and marriage certificates—are legitimate
